name: Marrow Warhammer
summary: A pale hammer that rattles bones loose and staggers its target.
description: The head is carved from something that is not quite stone and not quite bone. Gravediggers sometimes take it in trade for a hard burial.

stats.effect: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with it, the creature has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
